objective: Discriminate upstream candidate formation, system workspace selection, causal broadcast/receiver closure, model-internal workspace mediation, projection rail and re-entry on a target Qwen3-4B-class runtime.
primary_question: Does FRANK's system WorkspaceEpisode cause task-relevant receiver effects through independently measurable receiver closure and a separable model-internal workspace, rather than merely correlating with upstream selection or projection effects?

upstream_query_TCQS.rule: Hold query/search-space/collection semantics fixed inside the main factorial; run separate upstream falsifier blocks.

internal_workspace.method: Jacobian-lens or causally equivalent validated intervention if compatible with target checkpoint

quantization.conditional: where the exact target runtime supports matched checkpoints

receiver_universe.rule: Receiver membership may differ by FRANK implementation but must be declared before scoring globality.

key_predictions.nested_mediation: System workspace effect should be larger when model-internal uptake is intact if system→internal mediation is real.
key_predictions.external_recurrence: Truthful provenance-bound re-entry may partially rescue cross-turn continuity under internal-workspace lesion; shuffled/stale re-entry should not.
key_predictions.selective_broadcast: On sparse receiver-relevance tasks, selective/hybrid delivery may retain causal utility with lower cost than all-to-all.
key_predictions.capacity: Utility should peak at an intermediate capacity under distractor load rather than monotonically at maximum k.
key_predictions.ignition: Configured-threshold controls may show steep response curves but should fail history/recurrence or mechanism-rescue criteria.
key_predictions.projection: Changing rail/order can alter reconstruction/uptake without changing WorkspaceEpisode identity.
key_predictions.quantization: Internal workspace readout/mediation may change with quantization even when surface quality remains similar.

promotion_gate: No system-GWT promotion unless query/graph/workspace/projection/internal-uptake/reentry factors are separately identified and at least one target-Qwen causal intervention plus appropriate null/rescue succeeds.
consciousness_rule: No phenomenal-consciousness inference from any result in this experiment.
